source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The 1852699 landing removes the unused public dontDeliver attribute, while createAndSendMessage keeps its aDontDeliver method argument. Current MessageSend stores that input as _dontDeliver; createRFC822Message also sets it true, and _deliverMessage then reports completion without sending. A public member, a method argument and private implementation state are different contracts. The own review confirms this distinction, but required Bug discussion lacks a Thunderbird-only selection. These are source/review-only facts with zero full-audit credit; no real send operation ran.
title: Removing nsIMsgSend.dontDeliver does not remove the send-method argument
